summary: Adjusts two counters through double-indirect pointers on this: increments the dword at the pointer stored in this+0x2C and decrements the dword at the pointer stored in this+0x1C, returning the decremented value. Shape matches a putback of one narrow character into a buffered stream (available count up, read position back one). Invoked on the putback path from CharValidationAgainstEncodingTableWithLocaleFall.

local_names.this: stream/buffer object whose this+0x1C and this+0x2C hold pointers to the position and count dwords

operations.description: Increments the dword value at the pointer stored in this+0x2C by one; interpreted as raising an available/remaining count for a one-character putback.
Decrements the dword value at the pointer stored in this+0x1C by one; interpreted as stepping a read-position offset back one position.
Returns the post-decrement value read through this+0x1C.
Called on the putback path by CharValidationAgainstEncodingTableWithLocaleFall (0x00598FD4), which supplies the this object.

unresolved: The exact object contract behind this+0x1C and this+0x2C (position vs count semantics) is DERIVED from the raw body and the prior analysis, not independently confirmed.
Equal offsets on unrelated this pointers elsewhere are not proof the fields or owner class are identical.
